item.title: [New] ReFS on removable media: audit phase since the October 2026 update, blocking becomes the default with the January 2027 Windows security update
item.description:
Removable ReFS volumes are an unsupported, attacker-reachable file-system surface; the audit events list where blocking will break something in January.

Windows · Collect the ReFS audit events for removable media now, migrate the workflows they show, and enable blocking in a test ring before the January 2027 update makes it the default.

item.title: [New] Windows clients offer NTLM message signing by default from the November 2026 updates; servers require it from May 2027 (CVE-2026-118737)
item.description:
Default signing cuts NTLM relay exposure, and the new audit events are the list of devices and appliances that will be refused by servers in May 2027.

Windows · Install the November 2026 Windows updates, collect the NTLM signing audit events (KB5135557) to find clients and appliances that do not sign, and plan to require signing before May 2027.
